content:
Four-star legendary effects were introduced several years ago and were planned to be implemented in future updates, only to be indefinitely shelved. They were finally released in the December 2024 update in the form of mods. 4-star mods may be obtained by completing Raid: Gleaming Depths.

Unique weapons[]

Unique weapons which come with predetermined legendary effects. They may be obtained as quest, event or challenge rewards. Others may be crafted.

↑Anti-Armor: If armor penetration effects, such as the Stabilized or Tank Killer perks, are equipped, the armor reduction bonus is stacked multiplicatively with Anti-Armor.
Stacks additively with weapon mods that add armor penetration such as the Perforating Magazine. (Perforating magazine + Anti-armor = 90% penetration)

↑Berserker's: 0 = DR = +50% Damage 0 < DR ≤ 20 = +30% Damage 20 < DR ≤ 40 = +17% Damage 40 < DR ≤ 60 = +5% Damage 60 < DR = +0% Damage

↑Bloodied: 90% < HP ≤ 95% = +5% Damage 85% < HP ≤ 90% = +10% Damage 80% < HP ≤ 85% = +15% Damage 75% < HP ≤ 80% = +20% Damage 70% < HP ≤ 75% = +25% Damage 65% < HP ≤ 70% = +30% Damage 60% < HP ≤ 65% = +35% Damage 55% < HP ≤ 60% = +40% Damage 50% < HP ≤ 55% = +45% Damage 45% < HP ≤ 50% = +50% Damage 40% < HP ≤ 45% = +55% Damage 35% < HP ≤ 40% = +60% Damage 30% < HP ≤ 35% = +65% Damage 25% < HP ≤ 30% = +70% Damage 20% < HP ≤ 25% = +75% Damage 15% < HP ≤ 20% = +80% Damage 10% < HP ≤ 15% = +85% Damage 5% < HP ≤ 10% = +90% Damage 0% < HP ≤ 5% = +95% Damage

↑Furious: +5% damage per stack; nine stacks maximum for a total of +45% damage.

Stacks reset to 0 after not hitting the target for 10 seconds, but are not lost on missed attacks.

Stacks are reset on target swap, although the first attack on a new target may obtain the damage boost before resetting.

Shotguns and other multiple-projectile weapons count each individual "hit" as a stack.

Example: When using a shotgun with the explosive effect (16 total "hits"), if 9 or more "hits" from the first shot hit one creature, the second shot will receive the full +45% damage bonus. Further reading

↑Gourmand's: Damage bonuses from hunger and thirst are added together separately +12% Damage from Fully Fed and +12% Damage from Fully Hydrated 0-20% fill = +0% Damage 21-40% fill = +3% Damage 41-60% fill = +6% Damage 61-80% fill = +9% Damage 81-100% fill = +12% Damage

↑Instigating: +100% base damage; does not deal double damage

↑Juggernaut's: 0% < HP < 5% = +0% Damage 5% ≤ HP = +1% Damage 10% < HP ≤ 15% = +3% Damage 15% < HP ≤ 20% = +4% Damage 20% < HP ≤ 25% = +6% Damage 25% < HP ≤ 30% = +7% Damage 30% < HP ≤ 35% = +8% Damage 35% < HP ≤ 40% = +9% Damage 40% < HP ≤ 45% = +10% Damage 45% < HP ≤ 50% = +12% Damage 50% < HP ≤ 55% = +13% Damage 55% < HP ≤ 60% = +15% Damage 60% < HP ≤ 65% = +16% Damage 65% < HP ≤ 70% = +17% Damage 70% < HP ≤ 75% = +18% Damage 75% < HP ≤ 80% = +19% Damage 80% < HP ≤ 85% = +21% Damage 85% < HP ≤ 90% = +22% Damage 90% < HP ≤ 95% = +23% Damage 95% ≤ HP ≤ 100% = +25% Damage

↑Junkie's: Less than 5 active addictions: +10% Damage for each one 5 or more active addictions: +50% Damage

↑Medic's: Heals 5% of the player's max HP per second for 1 second for all teammates within the radius of 768

↑Stalker's: Multiplicative: ×2.0 VATS accuracy and ×2.0 AP Cost Does not actually cost +50% AP Not in combat means that combat music is not playing, or the player has not been detected

↑Two Shot: +25% Damage and adds an extra projectile, splitting weapon damage across all projectiles.

↑Vampire's: Heals limb damage. Gives 1% of the player's max HP for 2 seconds. Shotguns and other multiple projectile weapons heal per each projectile. For example if 8 projectiles hit a creature, player will be healed for total 16% of HP.

↑Crippling Additive Only increases limb condition damage, not actual damage dealt to HP bar

↑Explosive: Projectile overridden; will now explode for 20% base damage Reduces accuracy in VATS and increases spread Damage is not divided between projectiles, each deals 20% base damage

↑Hitman's: Additive: +25% damage Applies while aiming down with iron/glow/reflex sights and scopes. Will not apply when using VATS.

↑Ghost's: 10% chance to grant invisibility for 2 seconds

↑Nimble: +100% movespeed while aiming Applies while aiming down with iron sights, glow sights or reflex sights; will not apply when aiming with VATS or with a scope. Has no effect if the player has the Speed Demon mutation due to the mutation setting the player's movement speed to the game's maximum value.

↑Steadfast: Applies while aiming down with iron sights, glow sights or reflex sights. Will not apply when aiming with VATS or with a scope.

↑Cursed: +15% damage, +20% swing speed/fire rate, -4 durability Blocks the ability to be Legendary Crafted

↑Gunther's Big Iron: Provides also: +25% faster fire rate +20% more damage

↑Paranormal Applies to all Cryptids, not legendary craftable

↑Explosive (Shotguns): Projectile overridden; will now explode for 3% base damage Reduces accuracy in VATS and increases spread Damage is not divided between projectiles, each deals 3% base damage

Explosive - reduced the damage bonus from +100% to +20% of base weapon damage, with explosive radius damage.

Explosive (shotguns) - reduced the damage bonus from +100% to +3% of base weapon damage, with explosive radius damage.

Two Shot - reduced the damage bonus from +100% to +25% of base weapon damage.

Bugs[]

The following bugs have all been patched:

The Lightweight legendary effect would only reduce the base weight; mods to weapons would all weigh the same as usual.

The Two Shot legendary effect did not have its negative effects on accuracy and recoil listed.

Weapon Speed and Reload Speed both had the same name ("Rapid"). Reload Speed was later changed to "Swift." (Weapon speed and melee speed still have the same name, however.)

50% VATS Hit Chance and -25% VATS AP Cost had the same name ("VATS Enhanced"). -25% was later changed to "VATS Optimized."
